transcript.t: Music is part of my family life. My grandfather loves folk songs. Every evening he sits by the window and sings old songs from his village.
My mother plays the keyboard, and she often sings along to pop songs while she cooks. My older brother plays the electric guitar in a school band.
On weekends, our home is full of different sounds. At first, I thought it was too noisy. Now I understand that music brings us together, young and old.
